resources.string: SurSound Capture PoC
SurSound — audio capture PoC

Diagnostic only. Grant Android playback-capture consent, then play permitted audio in another app. Capture alone does not transmit. Sharing requires explicit consent, a local peer and a fresh pairing key. No microphone input, screen frames or audio storage.

Start the receiver first. Only permitted playback is sent, encrypted to this local peer, for up to 30 seconds. Stop at any time using the foreground notification. Use a fresh key and share it privately.

Start each selected receiver first. Only permitted app playback is encrypted and shared with these local devices for up to 30 seconds. Use one fresh key shared privately with this group. Receiver playout requires an authenticated clock. Stop using the foreground notification. Already transmitted buffered audio may briefly finish playing.
